slug: 2025-07-06 Home Affairs on launch of world-class new identity verification service and cost

systems.system: Identity verification service against the National Population Register
systems.tiers: Justice cluster users including SASSA, SAPS and the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development; the cluster runs over 180,000 transactions a day

note: Home Affairs' statement on its identity verification service, launched 1 July 2025; SAPS is named only as a justice-cluster user onboarded to it, and no station record system is described.
